objective: Reduce public posterior tail risk and actual hidden-label exposure while preserving or improving service TPS under the unchanged hardcore disaster environment.
scientific_parent: original-paper direct full-committee PPO plus reviewer-required public fair inputs

environment.original_registered_event: permanent 30 percent node kill at control step 1000
environment.additional_training_families: unchanged multihazard training families from hardcore v5

controller.family: direct PPO without FMG or residual prior
controller.security_cost: exact Poisson-binomial P(public posterior nonresponses in selected committee > f)
controller.public_admission: quarantine only when consecutive public deadline misses >=2 and public response trust LCB <0.45
controller.admission_below_k_mode: release exactly the deficit with the lowest public posterior risk; no hidden label and no post-action shield
controller.training_decoder: exact prefix-conditioned stochastic Plackett-Luce at temperature 0.55

runtime_corrigendum_1.reason: The first smoke claim failed before environment construction because the native-ext4 stage omitted the already-frozen calibration artifact.

qualification_corrigendum_2.trigger: The first 8-update qualification trained successfully, but deterministic deployment reached only 20 admitted nodes in one disaster state.
qualification_corrigendum_2.fix: Replace all-or-nothing failure below k with an exact-deficit, minimum-public-risk pre-action refill.

interpretation.single_seed_role: diagnostic candidate, not confirmatory paper evidence
interpretation.security_guard: Report both public chance-risk and offline actual exposure. Positive TPS does not establish safety.
interpretation.fundamental_limit: No public-telemetry policy can guarantee hidden committee composition at the first uninformative decision; cryptographic safety claims remain conditional on admission assumptions.
